name: io.github.sinhaKAN-ra/anumana
description: Predict a query's cost, explain how it runs, and rewrite it — before it runs — grounded in your real schema via EXPLAIN (never ANALYZE), across 12 database engines.

environmentVariables.name: ANUMANA_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Read-only connection string for the primary target database (e.g. postgresql://readonly@host:5432/db). Optional if ANUMANA_TARGETS is used.

environmentVariables.name: ANUMANA_TARGETS
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of named targets for a multi-database setup, each with name, engine, and connection string.

environmentVariables.name: ANUMANA_POLICIES
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of operator enforcement policies (block/warn/allow rules by risk tier or flag). Optional; open by default.
